conclusion: A CDP connection failure paused dispatch. One bounded running-monitor recovery was attempted, but the controller explicitly closed before recovery completed. Recovery stopped with MONITOR_CONTROLLER_CLOSED and the driver terminated the brain. A later reconnect was for stop/export only. The initiating connection failure remains unknown; the evidence does not justify reopening the closed controller or changing monitor policy.
